name: EESystem session – 120 minutes
description: Two hours in the same room, equipped with the EESystem, for anyone who wants the longest slot. It goes exactly like the 60-minute session: you stay clothed, in an armchair, on a lounger or on the sofa, with a blanket and water within reach, and nothing you have to do. You can come on your own or in a small group.
